title: zamia × katzeriana
intro: Zamia × katzeriana, commonly known as the Katzer's cycad, is a hybrid plant belonging to the Cycad family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Zamia × katzeriana include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents are responsible for its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against various pathogens.
